title: RAG is Dead #agenticai #ai #aiagents #generativeai #rag
description:
Everyone online is saying RAG is dead. 🔥

Page Index. Agentic RAG. CRAG. The alternatives keep coming.

But no one mentions the trade-off.

Page Index uses reasoning models — significantly more expensive than the embedding models in standard RAG. Agentic RAG costs 3x–5x more per query. CRAG adds an evaluation layer on every single retrieval.

Standard RAG is still the most cost-effective, lowest latency option. And with proper evaluation and a solid AI harness, it can be made highly accurate too.

Upgrade only when your use case demands it. Not because it is trending.

💾 Save this for your next RAG architecture decision.
